qt: "His approach to the gate was met with sounding trumpets and an unfurling of banners. He never saw it coming." - anonymous Brotherhood of Silence report
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood. Is there sweeter music?" - Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.
For those without a home in the Vastiri, the hot day is harsh, but the chill night is far worse.
Forged to rule the waves and tide Destined to serve the monkey's paw Strong as a tower of iron Deft as the needle doubt
If you see the blushing tree of the northern woods, remember: "Blossoms of red, the tree's been fed. Blossoms of white, prepare for a fight."
In a time of great need, surrounded by Abyssals, the Wayward Druid came to the Sun Clan's aid. It is a debt they have never forgotten.
The mark of the smith was widely known.
The might of the Eternal Empire was formidable, but rebels of every culture stood together as one.
The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.
The night Draven attacked, Erian was asleep at his post.
There was a very clear and delicious reason why the Ezomytes chose to stop their flight and settle in Phaaryl.
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often required to garnish the perfect confession." - Brutus, Warden of Axiom
"Do not despair! Give yourself to the woods! Become empty, and the Goddess will find you. From within her roots... you shall be restored." - Cirel of Caer Tarth
"Hold firm. Let no word but the Mothers' turn your head. Through your unfaltering fealty, you achieve perfection."
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men." - Taruk of the Wildmen
"I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."
"In the hands of Orbala, it made a god bleed." - Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara
"Move in ways your enemy does not expect. Confuse them with elegance and grace. They'll never see the axe coming." - Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe
"Power of the Red Pyre! Flaming Heart of the Hive! I release your burning message to rest here, forevermore." The Dreamer declared, casting out the lingering dark embers within him.
"Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful with those hooks!" - the Master Torturer's last words
"The boy is a bad omen," he cried. "Ravens gather before him!" That night, a new raven appeared, and shadowed the Auspex for the rest of his days.
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst carnage. Such is the nature of progress." - Doryani of the Vaal
"The rain of a thousand quills that whittle present into past, life into death." - Rigwald of the Ezomytes
"This was the first step in some grand design, lost to the ages, now ours to decipher." - Dominus, High Templar
"Those who dance are considered insane by those who cannot hear the music." - Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
"Toasted or frozen Or twitching in the light I'm not fussy And neither is Death." - Koralus Doomfletch
"True heroes grow stronger in the face of adversity." - Fourth Tenet of the Knights of the Sun
"What are you lot looking at? We're under fire! Get to your stations!" - Captain Sventura, the Unlucky
"When you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to fear." - Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
"You killed their Golden Sekhema. The Maraketh will think of nothing but vengeance now." - Dimos, Advisor to General Titucius

A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination. Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.
A faith born of flesh.
A gift from the Draíocht, lost in Darkness. The bronze hums. The cloth sighs. Living pieces of her, yearning to exist.
A hundred blind heads, each seeking the taste of prey on the air.
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.
A power unknown aids your own.
A sensitive few among the first settlers of Ezomyr followed the wisps by canoe. On a misty forested island, Cirel of Tarth stood waiting to greet them.
Although a great leader during the war, Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
An Ezomyte endures.
As the serpent wills.
As the sun rises and the light approaches, so too shall your enemies fear you.
Banished for his tragic failure, Erian learned to hunt to survive.
Be not deceived by the treachery of men.
Be not where death falls.
Born among the high peaks, many Mutewind live their entire lives in snow and ice.
Born in a star of man's own make, fused to her hand by her last mistake.
Curse their vile Council, They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child. If they only knew the power I possess.
Dannig saw Seren in his mind's eye, a public ornament of extravagance. Until she bore Cadigan a son and vanished. Decadence covering brutality, like all Kalguuran customs.
Each crest was a Thane's word, bolted to Ivor's bow. They would join the Count's side, or die by his hands.
Ezomyte loyalty was not given to distant leaders. It was earned by comrades in arms.
Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.
Feed a beast and it will not hunt. Protect it and it will not fight. Ferocity must be learned, not taught. It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
For those noble families obsessed with keeping their bloodline pure, there was a price to pay...
Fueled by the blackness in the hearts of men, the armies of Saresh were just as relentless.
Hallowed Dordalus was cast into the pit as a heretic, but his piety was so great, he would not burn. He rose again, lauded, his faith forever changed... but not the way the Templar believed.
He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
Heads fall to the sand, just as the star fell from the sky
His enemy was for endurance forged. His own waned.
His isolation caused him to treasure their companionship all the more.
His latent potential unleashed itself, a beast bursting from its shackles. Each strike of Farrow's hammer rang out a song for the First Ones.
Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows, tipped with a poisoned hatred only oppression can ferment.
In all things, control.
In an endless war against darkness, one must be ever vigilant.
In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.
In its final era, the roofs of Keth were rife with anything and everything that could hold water... should the opportunity arise.
In our tales, and in our hearts, the rivers still flow.
In the mists they dwell, forever hungry, forever cold.
Infinite mutations over endless eons borne upon it in a singular moment.
It is often said of nobles that they live off their peasants... sometimes, it's truer than any suspect.
It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery, that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.
Knowing she could outlast any opponent, Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.
Long ago, the witches of the Azak Tribe learned how to tap into the flow of Vivid lifeforce to 'cooperate' with their enemies... forcefully.
Look the storm in the eye and you will have its respect.
Mortality is a curse. The cure is simple.
My Soul is your Strength My Price is your Blood
Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.
Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.
Reap what others have sown Muster them from their graves Parade them for your pleasure Zealots in mortis enslaved
Secrecy and silence are powers all their own.
Shedding away her regal past, she forged a new destiny. Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man, she embraced the eternal grasp of nature. Seizing her one true wish, she found peace at last.
Sibilant promises surrounded them in the night. All the travelers had to give him was their devotion...
Smithed from ancient metal wrought from the very stars. It is a means to call upon them, for one capable of wielding it.
Some would question if the risk was worth it. The rest were already dead.
Suspicion is a sinister shadow slithering in the soul.
That day, both the Unblinking Eye and their enemies stood in silence. That day, the sky was clear, but it was raining.
The Abyssals were created, not born, and every moment in the light was agony.
The Baleful Gem's corruption lingers still...
The Sacred Hunt ends with mercy.
The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other. What hope have you?
The Twilight Order rejected the gods, choosing instead to put their faith in each other.
The Unblinking Eye did not cower and wail. They stood against the end.
The art of surgery advances one mistake at a time.
The blasted oak stands forever.
The collector need not even speak. Each ring regaled them with tales of his conquest.
The dead man walks where the living fear to tread.
The desert is ever flowing.
The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.
The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.
The final element the tale-women mastered was Time itself.
The first witch hunter knew one critical tactic: never let your enemy have a clear moment.
The forests of the Vastiri held many secrets mystical and dark. Men learned not to wander, lest they return with a strange new purpose.
The gleam of the night and howling teeth alike could not abate the rising of the sun.
The greatest mistakes cause suffering long after they have been made
The mournful music of the strings, The creaking arch, the arrow sings. A choking cry, a rattled breath, The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly. Whether in one day or in ten thousand years, eventually the rock will crumble, and the Brine King's domain will grow.
The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.
The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.
The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around. Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.
The warrior who fears will fall.
The world churned during the Great Wasting. Tawhoa may have stilled the rioting earth, but it was Valako that tamed the broken sky.
There is no safer place Than the Belly of the Beast
